headline: Sri Lankan Equities Drop Following Surprise Central Bank Interest Rate Hike
summary: Sri Lankan shares fell 0.8% on Friday to log their worst weekly decline in six months after the central bank unexpectedly raised its key policy rate by 25 basis points. The CSE All Share Index fell to 21,369.72.
why: The Colombo Stock Exchange operates the primary equity market in Sri Lanka.

impacts.name: CSE All Share Index
impacts.why: A surprise 25-basis-point central bank rate hike raised borrowing costs and depressed stock valuations.

why_moved: An unexpected monetary policy rate hike by Sri Lanka's central bank prompted a broad-based equity sell-off.
